{
  "found": true,
  "rule": {
    "trigger_kind": "incident",
    "event": "sfp_replaced",
    "symptoms": [
      "link_up",
      "counters_zero"
    ],
    "stated_condition": "older transmission units",
    "condition_is_relative": true,
    "action": "interface.bounce",
    "action_text": "disabling and enabling the interface once",
    "avoid": [
      "sfp.replace",
      "node.reboot"
    ],
    "excerpt": "Before replacing the SFP again or rebooting the unit, check the traffic counters.\n\nIf the interface is UP but the counters remain at zero, try disabling and enabling the interface once.",
    "said_by": "Erkki Expert",
    "said_by_role": "expert",
    "hedged": false,
    "first_hand": true,
    "outcome": "unknown",
    "outcome_excerpt": null,
    "about_entity": "TRN-042"
  },
  "reason": "An expert states a reusable rule for when traffic does not recover after SFP replacement on older transmission units: if the interface is UP and counters remain at zero, bounce the interface rather than replacing the SFP again or rebooting."
}
